Delivers through consultants, assessment data and digital platforms for talent strategy, hiring and leadership development.

primary_services.value: executive search; recruitment process outsourcing; talent and organizational consulting; leadership development; professional search and interim staffing

revenue_model.value: service fees: retained executive search fees and consulting engagements; project or contract: recruitment process outsourcing and professional search contracts; subscription: digital talent platform and assessment subscriptions; licensing or royalties: licensed leadership content and intellectual property
